# Tier 1A: Urban Cultural & Educational Metropolis (+25% local assimilation, literacy & institution spread)
oe_cul2_urban_melting_pot = {
	type = location
	category = location
	potential_trigger = {
		has_owner = yes
		OR = {
			location_rank = location_rank:town
			location_rank = location_rank:city
			location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
		}
		local_control >= 0.50
		OR = {
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = university
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = library
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = theater
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = opera_house
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = confucian_academy
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = madrasa
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = great_madrasa
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = al_azhar_madrasa
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = arts_academy
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = academy_of_sciences
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = printing_press_shop
			has_building_with_at_least_one_level = scriptorium
		}
	}
	local_pop_assimilation_speed_modifier = 0.25
	local_monthly_literacy = 0.005
	local_institution_growth_modifier = 0.05
}

# Tier 3A: Low-Control Rural or Unroaded Mountain/Desert/Arctic/Jungle Friction (-35% assimilation)
oe_cul2_rural_heartland_friction = {
	type = location
	category = location
	potential_trigger = {
		has_owner = yes
		is_capital = no
		owner = {
			capital ?= {
				region != root.region
			}
		}
		OR = {
			AND = {
				location_rank = location_rank:rural_settlement
				local_control < 0.40
			}
			AND = {
				num_roads = 0
				OR = {
					topography = mountains
					vegetation = desert
					vegetation = jungle
					climate = arctic
				}
			}
		}
	}
	local_pop_assimilation_speed_modifier = -0.35
}

# Tier 3B: Extreme Unroaded Backwater Friction (stacks with Tier 3A to -50% total until roads/control built)
oe_cul2_remote_low_control_friction = {
	type = location

		has_owner = yes
		is_capital = no
		location_rank = location_rank:rural_settlement

		num_roads = 0
	}
	local_pop_assimilation_speed_modifier = -0.15
}

oe_cul2_frontier_settlement_pull = {
	type = location

	potential_trigger = {
